summary: Iteration 3 (newsletter/luxe/admin). Backend: new suite test_nocturne_extras.py has 30 tests and all 30 pass. They cover register with consent fields, preferences toggle, partners and the category filter, partner bookings (20% fee, validation, mine), journal published/draft visibility, admin RBAC 403 on 8 endpoints, overview revenue math, members list, CSV export (opted-in only), journal CRUD and validation, a real Claude draft stream (title/summary/body format OK), booking confirm then a second change returning 400 with partner_fees updated, and withdrawal_fees recorded. Regression test_nocturne_api.py: 23/23 pass. Frontend (375px mobile web) checked: sign-up with phone/city and the opt-in box ticked by default (saved to DB); Explore segments venues/luxe/journal; Luxe chips filter; partner booking with day/units/guests/notes (DB values correct); Profile Luxe Requests list, marketing switch (saved to DB) and admin button shown only to admins; /admin blocked for non-admins; admin revenue card and stats, Export CSV download with export-msg, journal list, confirm/decline with revenue/pending updating live; compose with category, empty-topic check, draft filling title/summary/body (the draft endpoint was MOCKED in the UI test with page.route to stay within the 2 LLM calls), edit existing article then publish, and the article showing in the Journal. One HIGH bug: compose creates duplicate articles. Image issues on 2 partners.

minor.issue: The CSV is open to formula injection. User-controlled full_name/city values starting with = + - @ are written as-is and will run as formulas in Excel/Sheets. Prefix such cells with a single quote (').
gen() has no try/except. If the LLM fails mid-stream after the 200 header is sent, the client gets a cut-off body with no error. Catch the exception and yield/log an error marker.
An unknown category returns 200 [] instead of 400. The PARTNER_CATEGORIES constant is never used for validation.
No upper limit on the date (bookings years ahead are accepted). The UI only offers 14 days.
membership_mrr_estimate counts the free self-serve 'member' tier (guest/promoter seed users) at $14.99, so the MRR is overstated.

ui_bugs.issue: After creating a new article, the screen stays on /admin/compose with no id. Saving again (for example: Save draft, toggle publish, Publish) calls createArticle a second time and creates a DUPLICATE article. Reproduced: two 'TEST_ DupCheck' docs, one published and one draft. Fix: store the returned id (setId or router.replace(`/admin/compose?id=${created.id}`)) or router.back() after save. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/compose.tsx:82-83

issues: 'Newport Luxe Yachts' cover image shows a scuba diver with fish, not a yacht (seed.py partner image_url)
'Royal Stretch Limousines' image shows a small Fiat 500 hatchback, not a limousine
'The Sunset Grand' (West Hollywood hotel) shows a tropical thatched-roof resort. Weak match.
The opt-in Pressable has no accessibilityRole='checkbox' or accessibilityState={{checked}}, so screen readers can't announce whether it is ticked (sign-up.tsx:138)

action_items: HIGH: Fix the duplicate article creation in admin/compose.tsx. After createArticle succeeds, switch to edit mode with the returned id, or navigate back.
Replace the partner images for Newport Luxe Yachts (scuba diver) and Royal Stretch Limousines (Fiat 500) with relevant yacht/limo photos in seed.py. Consider The Sunset Grand too.
Sanitize CSV cells against formula injection in /api/admin/members/export.
Add error handling inside the draft stream generator (extras.py:224).
Optional: validate the partner category filter (400 for unknown values), cap the booking date range, and stop counting the free 'member' tier in the MRR estimate.
critical_code_review_comments: extras.py is clean: _id excluded everywhere, admin RBAC via require_roles, booking status change is atomic (filter status=requested).
Partner booking date is built client-side as local 18:00 then toISOString(). Users outside UTC will see the stored UTC day/time shift. Consider sending a date plus a local time string.
The legacy regression test test_nocturne_api.py left a withdrawals record behind (withdrawals are now persisted). I updated its cleanup to remove records it creates.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_nocturne_api.py (cleanup of withdrawals created by the run)

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all requested flows work; compose duplicate-save bug)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Removed by id: TEST_ users (incl. the UI sign-up user), partner bookings, articles, withdrawals. The seeded promoter wallet float drift (-2.2e-16) was reset to 0.0. DB is back to 4 seeded users, 0 bookings, 0 withdrawals, 3 seeded articles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. xdist is on by default and breaks the module-level STATE sharing in test_nocturne_extras.py. The real LLM draft was called twice (budget used). The UI compose test mocked /api/admin/journal/draft via page.route, so real streaming into inputs on web (expo/fetch getReader) was not seen end to end in the browser. Partner page has a sticky bottom bar: avoid force=True clicks on units +/- because they hit the request button.
rca_of_issue: Compose duplicate: the `id` comes only from useLocalSearchParams. onSave branches on `id ? updateArticle : createArticle` and never captures the created article's id, so every save of a new article does a POST.
